rootCause: Node v25.9.0 native fetch replaced the loopback fixture Host header with 127.0.0.1:port. Direct connector authentication succeeded, but the actual HTTP request failed hostname authentication before the reservation ledger ran.
fix: Use built-in node:http for the owned loopback fixture; assert the public hostname at the server boundary. Keep production authentication, quotas, ledger and public error redaction intact. Add prerequisite checks and test-only HTTP/forwarded-error diagnostics.
